name: ui-apexpages-current-page-test-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: The fixture proves the local test harness current-page slot and does not claim hosted Visualforce execution.

evidence.notes: Installs PageReference values through the Object overload for local tests.

source.content: @isTest private class UiApexPagesCurrentPageTest { @isTest static void tracksTwoPageTransitions() { Test.setCurrentPage(new PageReference('/apex/FirstPage?state=one')); System.assertEquals('/apex/FirstPage?state=one', ApexPages.currentPage().getUrl()); Object second = new PageReference('/apex/SecondPage?state=two'); Test.setCurrentPage(second); System.assertEquals('/apex/SecondPage?state=two', ApexPages.currentPage().getUrl()); System.assertEquals('two', ApexPages.currentPage().getParameters().get('state')); } }
